content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp
System time of event creation.
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
TargetFileName
The resulting file name that was downloaded
Size
Size of the egressing file in bytes.
UserName
Operating system username.
MD5HashData
The MD5 hash of a file
SHA1HashData
The SHA1 hash of a file.  In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
SHA256HashData
The SHA256 hash of a file. In most cases, the hash of the file referred to by the ImageFileName field.
Values:
STATIC_SHA256_DOPPELGANGING (0x56f3097c4d5bf4c7cffef168ee732e1c78f2ee62bc1c1ba61c219226bef619f8)
STATIC_SHA256_SYSTEM (0x03312a19baa7ab137c09127c6feb58c05216a7880d3c9e6ae54a8bcda460f92a)
FileHeader
Header of a file, intended to hold a small amount of data (16 bytes), usefulfor determining basic file types (MachO, shell script, etc.)
UnixGroupName
Name of a unix group account.
UnixMode
Describes the traditional Unix permissions of a file system entry (eg. 0755).
PosixFileType
File type returned by POSIX stat()
Values:
NON (0)
REG (1)
DIR (2)
BLK (3)
CHR (4)
LNK (5)
SOCK (6)
FIFO (7)
FileAttributes
File attributes
UserSecurityDomain
Domain for the file/process/registry owner (mapped from SID).
CompanyName
ImageInternalName
The Internal Name of the PE, extracted from VersionInfo resource.
FileOwnerSid
UserSid
The User Security Identifier (UserSID) of the user who executed the command. A UserSID uniquely identifies a user in a system.
Values:
SELF_RID (0x01010000000000050A000000)
FileDescription
Description of a file.
FileVersion
FileLegalCopyRight
CertificateExists
OriginalFilename
The OriginalFilename of the PE, extracted from VersionInfo resource.
ProductName
ProductVersion
SourceFileName
The file's original name
AlternateDataStreamName
